source.scriptBlock: data/battle_scripts_1.s:762-776 BattleScript_EffectOHKO -- attackcanceler / attackstring / ppreduce / `accuracycheck BattleScript_ButItFailed, NO_ACC_CALC_CHECK_LOCK_ON` / typecalc / jumpifmovehadnoeffect / `tryKO BattleScript_KOFail` / trysetdestinybondtohappen / goto BattleScript_HitFromAtkAnimation. There is NO `jumpifability BS_TARGET, ABILITY_STURDY` in the script: the STURDY guard lives inside Cmd_tryKO. NO_ACC_CALC_CHECK_LOCK_ON makes the script's own accuracycheck draw nothing, and the goto target skips critcalc/damagecalc, so an OHKO hit spends no crit or damage roll.
source.commandBlock: src/battle_script_commands.c:7490-7573 Cmd_tryKO -- (1) target Focus Band: `if (holdEffect == HOLD_EFFECT_FOCUS_BAND && (Random() % 100) < param)`, short-circuited so a non-Focus-Band target costs no draw; (2) `if (gBattleMons[gBattlerTarget].ability == ABILITY_STURDY)` sets MOVE_RESULT_MISSED, gLastUsedAbility = ABILITY_STURDY, gBattlescriptCurrInstr = BattleScript_SturdyPreventsOHKO and RecordAbilityBattle -- this precedes every accuracy draw; (3) otherwise `chance = gBattleMoves[gCurrentMove].accuracy + (attackerLevel - targetLevel)` and `Random() % 100 + 1 < chance && attackerLevel >= targetLevel` -- exactly ONE draw, unless STATUS3_ALWAYS_HITS + gDisableStructs[target].battlerWithSureHit == attacker takes the Lock-On branch, which draws none; (4) on success gBattleMoveDamage = target hp (or hp - 1 under endure/Focus Band) and MOVE_RESULT_ONE_HIT_KO; on failure MOVE_RESULT_MISSED with gBattleCommunication[MULTISTRING_CHOOSER] = B_MSG_KO_MISS (attacker level >= target level) or B_MSG_KO_UNAFFECTED.
source.strings: data/battle_scripts_1.s:772-776 BattleScript_KOFail -> `printfromtable gKOFailedStringIds`; src/battle_message.c:1108-1112 gKOFailedStringIds = { [B_MSG_KO_MISS] = STRINGID_ATTACKMISSED, [B_MSG_KO_UNAFFECTED] = STRINGID_PKMNUNAFFECTED }. data/battle_scripts_1.s:4066-4070 BattleScript_SturdyPreventsOHKO -> `printstring STRINGID_PKMNPROTECTEDBY`. The success string is STRINGID_ONEHITKO (include/constants/battle_string_ids.h:218).
source.kingsRock: src/battle_util.c:3769-3779 ITEMEFFECT_KINGSROCK_SHELLBELL is wrapped in `if (gBattleMoveDamage)`, and its HOLD_EFFECT_FLINCH arm evaluates `(Random() % 100) < atkHoldEffectParam` BEFORE testing `gBattleMoves[gCurrentMove].flags & FLAG_KINGS_ROCK_AFFECTED` (FISSURE lacks that flag, so it could never flinch through one anyway). MEASURED: DUGTRIO's KING'S ROCK draws NOTHING in any of the three arms. BattleScript_EffectOHKO reaches moveendall (and therefore MOVEEND_KINGSROCK_SHELLBELL, battle_script_commands.c:4336-4338) only after `tryfaintmon BS_TARGET`, and on an OHKO hit the outer `if (gBattleMoveDamage)` guard is already false by then; on a miss and on a STURDY refusal the script leaves for BattleScript_MoveEnd with gBattleMoveDamage never set at all.
source.secondaryEffect: src/battle_script_commands.c:2908-2936 Cmd_seteffectwithchance -- its `else if (Random() % 100 < percentChance && gBattleCommunication[MOVE_EFFECT_BYTE] && ...)` evaluates Random() FIRST, so the opcode costs a draw even for a move with secondaryEffectChance 0 like FISSURE. It sits in BattleScript_HitFromAtkAnimation (data/battle_scripts_1.s:253-266), which only the HIT arm reaches: BattleScript_KOFail and BattleScript_SturdyPreventsOHKO both goto BattleScript_MoveEnd and skip it.

drawCountsPerFissureResolution.note: hit = 1 Cmd_tryKO accuracy draw (frame 67, before the HP write at frame 268) + 1 Cmd_seteffectwithchance draw (frame 359, unconditional even at secondaryEffectChance 0). miss = the accuracy draw only; BattleScript_KOFail skips seteffectwithchance. sturdy = none: the ability branch returns before the accuracy draw, and BattleScript_SturdyPreventsOHKO skips seteffectwithchance too. KING'S ROCK contributes nothing in any arm -- see kingsRockControl.

levelGate: Unreachable in Factory version 1: both sides are fixed Level 50, so `attackerLevel - targetLevel` is 0 (chance == the move's own accuracy, 30 for FISSURE) and `attackerLevel >= targetLevel` is always true. B_MSG_KO_UNAFFECTED (STRINGID_PKMNUNAFFECTED) is therefore not reachable from a Level-50 singles Factory battle.
lockOnBranch: No fourth arm is possible: no rental set in src/data/gen/battle-frontier-mons.json carries MOVE_LOCK_ON or MOVE_MIND_READER at all (0 of 882 entries), so STATUS3_ALWAYS_HITS can never be staged Factory-legally alongside one of the 24 OHKO-carrying sets.

messageEvents.text:
Foe FORRETRESS was protected
by STURDY!

assertions: HIT (seed 305419897, METAPOD set 8): FISSURE draws exactly ONE Random() before the KO (frame 67), METAPOD 125 -> 0 at frame 268 with gMoveResultFlags = 20 (MOVE_RESULT_ONE_HIT_KO | MOVE_RESULT_NOT_VERY_EFFECTIVE -- GROUND is 0.5x on BUG), and the ROM prints “It’s a one-hit KO!” then “Foe METAPOD\nfainted!”. A second draw follows at frame 359 and belongs to Cmd_seteffectwithchance's unconditional Random(), NOT to KING'S ROCK -- see kingsRockControl.

MISS (seed 2, same parties): FISSURE draws exactly ONE Random(), gBattlescriptCurrInstr reaches BattleScript_KOFail at frame 67, the ROM prints “DUGTRIO’s\nattack missed!” (gKOFailedStringIds[B_MSG_KO_MISS] = STRINGID_ATTACKMISSED), METAPOD's HP never moves off 125, and neither Cmd_seteffectwithchance nor KING'S ROCK draws, because BattleScript_KOFail leaves straight for BattleScript_MoveEnd with gBattleMoveDamage never set.

STURDY (seed 305419897, FORRETRESS set 575, ability 5): FISSURE draws ZERO Random() -- Cmd_tryKO's ability branch fires before the accuracy draw. gBattlescriptCurrInstr reaches BattleScript_SturdyPreventsOHKO at frame 67 with gLastUsedAbility = 5 (STURDY), FORRETRESS's HP stays 150, and the ROM prints “Foe FORRETRESS was protected\nby STURDY!” (STRINGID_PKMNPROTECTEDBY).
All three arms spend exactly one FISSURE PP (5 -> 4), so the STURDY refusal is a refusal of the KO, not of the move.
No crit or damage roll appears in any arm: BattleScript_EffectOHKO gotos BattleScript_HitFromAtkAnimation past critcalc/damagecalc, and gBattleMoveDamage comes straight from Cmd_tryKO.
This is semantic RAM evidence; no framebuffer fitting or runtime oracle dependency is used.

KING'S ROCK (item 187, kept from set 564) never draws in any arm; the no-item control run reproduces the HIT arm's draw frames and final gRngValue exactly. The engine DIVERGES here -- see engineDivergence.

kingsRockControl.what: One-off control run (not a committed arm): the HIT fixture with the DUGTRIO's item forced to 0. If KING'S ROCK had drawn, the draw count and the post-draw cursor would move.
kingsRockControl.verdict: Identical to the KING'S ROCK arm -- same 2 draws at frames 67/359 and the same resulting gRngValue -- so frame 359 belongs to Cmd_seteffectwithchance, not to the item.

engineDivergence.what: The committed engine draws THREE Random() calls on the OHKO hit arm -- tryko, seteffectwithchance, and a third for KING'S ROCK's flinch chance -- where the stock ROM draws two. src/engine/battleScriptMoveEndOpcode.ts:885 mirrors battle_util.c:3770's `if (gBattleMoveDamage)` guard, but at MOVEEND_KINGSROCK_SHELLBELL time the ROM's gBattleMoveDamage is already 0 for an OHKO that fainted the target (moveendall runs after `tryfaintmon BS_TARGET`), while the engine's rules.battleMoveDamage is still non-zero.
engineDivergence.impact: Cursor drift only, and only on an OHKO hit: the target still dies and the KO string is still printed, but every later draw in that battle is off by one. FISSURE is not FLAG_KINGS_ROCK_AFFECTED, so no flinch is ever produced either way.
engineDivergence.documentedBy: tests/gate6OhkoReceipt.test.ts -- the `it.fails` case named for this divergence.
